message.content:
1) **Hero section**: Visually striking—dark background, yellow "aldri sur!" accent, trust badges (Fratrutt, 30 dager, etc.), and Kleven store image with northern lights create strong impact.  
2) **Products section**: Clear group headers (Fiskeutstyr, Pop-up Telt, Ild & Grill, etc.) with consistent product cards (images, names, prices) for easy navigation.  
3) **Alternating backgrounds**: Yes—light beige/white sections alternate with darker product blocks (e.g., Fiskeutstyr, Ild & Grill) for visual rhythm.  
4) **Brand promise band**: Present—dark navy footer with 3 columns (Kvalitetsutstyr, Rask Levering, Lokal Forhandler) reinforces trust.  
5) **Overall polish**: Significantly improved—layers, contrast, and structured sections replace a flat layout, looking professional and cohesive.
